evals.name: dry-run-default-no-mutation
evals.prompt:
/repo-fleet-hygiene:sync --root ~/repos

Four checkouts sit on feature branches and two are already on main.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs sync-fleet.sh without --apply and prints the dry-run plan: which checkouts switch to the remote default branch and fast-forward, which are skipped, and which would be parked. Nothing is switched, pulled, stashed, or parked. It names --apply as the way to act on the plan.
expectations: Invokes sync-fleet.sh without --apply
Presents the plan as a dry run that changes nothing
Names --apply (with one confirmation, or --yes) as the way to apply it

evals.name: non-fast-forward-is-skipped-not-reset
evals.prompt:
/repo-fleet-hygiene:sync --root ~/repos --apply --yes

One checkout's local main has a commit the remote main does not, so its history diverged.
evals.expected_output: That checkout is reported as skipped (non-fast-forward). The skill does not reset, rebase, or force the branch; the other checkouts still fast-forward.
expectations: Reports the diverged checkout as skipped with a non-fast-forward reason
Does not reset or force-update the branch
Still applies the plan to the other checkouts

evals.name: apply-without-terminal-needs-yes
evals.expected_output: With --apply and no terminal for the confirmation prompt, the script exits 3 and nothing changes. The skill reports that and names --apply --yes as the non-interactive consent.
expectations: Treats --apply without a terminal and without --yes as a stop
Changes nothing on that stop
Names --yes as the non-interactive consent flag

evals.name: dirty-branch-is-parked-in-worktree
evals.prompt:
/repo-fleet-hygiene:sync --repo ~/repos/widget --apply --yes --worktree-create /path/to/worktree-create.sh

widget is on branch feat/x with uncommitted edits, and its git config sets worktreeroot.path.
evals.expected_output: The dirty work on feat/x is parked: stashed, the checkout switches to the default branch, a linked worktree is created for feat/x by the helper the operator named with --worktree-create, called with --existing-branch and without --root, and the stash is applied there. The canonical checkout is then fast-forwarded. The branch is not deleted.
expectations: Parks the dirty non-default branch in a linked worktree rather than discarding it
Uses only the helper path given with --worktree-create, with --existing-branch, and does not search for a helper
Does not pass --worktree-root, so the helper resolves the root from the repository's worktreeroot.path
Fast-forwards the canonical checkout on the default branch afterwards
Does not delete the feature branch

evals.name: no-scope-exits-naming-the-rungs
evals.prompt:
/repo-fleet-hygiene:sync

No fleet config exists, ghq is not installed, and the working directory is not a Git checkout.
evals.expected_output: No scope rung resolves, so the script exits 3 with a message naming every rung (explicit paths, fleet config, --named, ghq root, the working directory). The skill relays that guidance and does not fall back to the project directory or pick a root itself.
expectations: Reports the exit-3 no-scope stop and the rungs it names
Does not treat the project directory as an implicit repository
Does not invent a root to sync

evals.name: dirty-branch-without-helper-is-skipped
evals.prompt:
/repo-fleet-hygiene:sync --repo ~/repos/widget --apply --yes

widget is on branch feat/x with uncommitted edits. No --worktree-create was given, and the source-control plugin is installed.
evals.expected_output: The script does not look for the source-control plugin's helper. widget is skipped as worktree-create-missing with a remedy naming --worktree-create and /source-control:worktree create --existing-branch, nothing is stashed, and the run exits 1. The skill reports the skip and does not locate or pass a helper on its own.
expectations: Reports widget as skipped with the reason worktree-create-missing
Changes nothing in widget: no stash, no branch switch
Does not search for the source-control plugin's worktree-create.sh or add --worktree-create itself
Relays the remedy: pass --worktree-create <path>, or park by hand with /source-control:worktree create --existing-branch
